storageDecision.question: Which bounded filesystem/volume should hold the proposed 24 GiB scratch space?
storageDecision.response: Docker can run without quotas. The proposed hard disk boundary protects shared Kubernetes storage from Docker image/build/log growth. 24 GiB is an initial ceiling; a bounded dedicated volume can provide the same boundary. Monitoring/stop thresholds reduce risk without guaranteeing a hard cap.
